Container.Name: novacortex-ollama
Container.Overview:
Ollama as the local AI sidecar for the NovaCortex stack. Install this and NovaCortex computes embeddings — and optionally its memory intelligence — on your own hardware, so no memory text ever leaves the server. Ollama itself is by Ollama Inc; this template is maintained by Nova Cognitive Systems, and support below goes to the NovaCortex issue tracker.
Optional 6th container. Install it before novacortex-api, on the same network:
0. docker network create novacortex (once, if you have not already) 1. novacortex-redis 2. novacortex-surrealdb 3. novacortex-qdrant novacortex-ollama (this template — optional, but before the API) 4. novacortex-api 5. novacortex-web
AFTER STARTING THIS CONTAINER, PULL A MODEL. Nothing works until you do:
docker exec novacortex-ollama ollama pull nomic-embed-text
That is the embedding model, ~275 MB. For the optional intelligence layer as well, also pull a chat model — qwen3:8b needs roughly 5-6 GB of RAM or VRAM:
docker exec novacortex-ollama ollama pull qwen3:8b
THEN SET FOUR FIELDS ON THE novacortex-api TEMPLATE:
Embeddings: Base URL http://novacortex-ollama:11434/v1 Embeddings: API Key ollama (any non-empty value; Ollama ignores it) Embeddings: Model nomic-embed-text Embeddings: Vector Size 768 (nomic-embed-text is 768-dimensional)
Vector Size has to match the model. Switching an existing install from OpenAI's 1536 to 768 needs a FRESH Qdrant collection — old vectors have the wrong dimension and everything has to be re-embedded. For the intelligence layer, additionally set Intelligence: LLM Model to qwen3:8b.
On the Compose path this whole container is the "local-ai" profile instead, and scripts/gen-env.sh --unraid --local-embeddings (or --local-ai) writes the same settings into your .env. See templates/unraid/README.md.
Notes: - It publishes no ports, matching the Compose stack — only containers on the novacortex network reach it. Pull models with docker exec as shown above; no port needed. - CPU-only works and is fine for embeddings. For an NVIDIA GPU, install the "Nvidia Driver" plugin from Community Apps, then add --runtime=nvidia and the NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES variable for your card in Extra Parameters. - Models are big. The default path below puts them in appdata; move it to a cache pool or another share if that suits your server better.
Container.Description:
Ollama runs open-weight language and embedding models locally behind an OpenAI-compatible API. NovaCortex talks to it exactly as it would to OpenAI, so pointing the API's embeddings base URL at this container is all it takes to keep every byte of memory text on your own hardware — the privacy-first path NovaCortex is built around.
Used for two separate things: embeddings for semantic search (nomic-embed-text), and optionally the intelligence layer that extracts facts from conversations and resolves conflicting memories append-only (a chat model such as qwen3:8b).
Container.Requires: A user-defined Docker network named "novacortex" (docker network create novacortex). At least one model pulled with docker exec after first start. Enough RAM for the models you pull — embeddings alone are light, a chat model wants several GB. Only useful together with the rest of the NovaCortex stack.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: novacortex ollama local ai embeddings offline privacy llm nomic-embed-text mcp self-hosted agents

Config.Name: Model Storage
Config.Description: Where pulled models are stored. Expect several GB per chat model. Must be an absolute path on the array or a pool — never the boot flash.

Config.Name: Context Length
Config.Description: Ollama's own default is 4096 tokens, which is too small for NovaCortex's ingest and reader prompts — it truncates them silently, which looks like the model simply not finding anything. 16384 fits alongside qwen3:8b in about 10 GB of VRAM. Lower it only if you are short on memory.

Config.Name: Keep Model Loaded
Config.Description: How long a model stays in memory after its last request. Longer means faster follow-up queries and more RAM held; 0 unloads immediately.
